data.summary:
**When:** [Opponent's turn](vsdata:core-rule/player-turns), as it ends.

**Target:** A **LEGIONES DAEMONICA** unit of yours, or instead up to 2 **LEGIONES DAEMONICA** units of yours that are all in [your army's Shadow of Chaos](vsdata:ability/chaos-daemons.the-shadow-of-chaos).

**Effect:** The unit goes into [Strategic Reserves](vsdata:core-rule/strategic-reserves). During [your next Movement phase](vsdata:core-rule/movement-phase), even in your first turn, it has to make an [ingress move](vsdata:core-rule/ingress-move).

**Restrictions:** The Stratagem cannot target a unit in [Engagement Range](vsdata:core-rule/engagement-range) of any enemy units.
